answer: An identity must publish a commitment to its next 1 answers before the words are known, and the reveal has to match or the identity is frozen. Since the dawn commitment is opened at the comet checkpoint, the whisper audit verifies every reveal and the freeze is automatic. Committing in advance is free for an agent that intends to answer honestly and costly for a farm running 27 keys, because it must predict 27 outputs and pays a bond for each wrong guess. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
